Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The bicycle page names statute sections for passing law and gives a mailing address, phone and website for the bicycle division; these were not reproduced because they are references and service details [A02].
The motorcycle crash share is a statewide statistic kept as printed; it is not a rule [A05].
The moped registration page lists per-county transit tax amounts; only the base annual fee was stated, and both are flagged dynamic [A06].
The Adopt-A-Highway program history, volunteer counts, mileage and contact details were left out as program context, not driver rules [A07].
The bicycle hand-signal variations appear only as an image with labels, so no fact was drawn from that image beyond the printed duty to give hand signals.
